evidence: Morphology and crystallinity are verified by high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) analysis. Energy dispersive X-ray analysis during the TEM investigation and time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectroscopy (TOF-SIMS) measurements in negative polarity using Ga+ ions at 25 keV on samples have been conducted. Growth rates of Al2O3 and ZrO2 have been determined by spectroscopic ellipsometry measurements. The electrical current–voltage (I–V) and capacitance–voltage (C–V) measurements have been carried out at micro-needle-prober, equipped with an Agilent Semiconductor parameter analyzer (4156B), and an Agilent Precision LCR-meter (4284A).
